_about: The fact database. A fact that appears on more than one page lives here once and is rendered everywhere it is needed, so one verified change propagates across the site. status: verified = an editor read the cited source and it supports the value; reported = credible reports or a located official page say so but an editor has not confirmed it; not_verified = carried over from earlier copy with no source; disputed = sources disagree (every alternative is shown, none is silently chosen). A verified fact needs source.url, verifiedAt and verifiedBy. 'topic' decides how quickly it goes stale (data/site-config.json > freshness).

facts.subject: Kumbh Mela passes and registration
facts.fact: A general-visitor e-pass or registration is required to attend
facts.display: Not confirmed — no such requirement has been found in official sources

source.name: Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Authority

facts.notes: What has been reported: online registration for religious and charitable organisations (QR single-window) and for student volunteers ('Kumbhdoot'), and administrative approval for a web portal and mobile app. A general-pilgrim e-pass has not been announced in any source we could locate. Until the Authority says otherwise, do not tell visitors a pass is required or that none is. Update 22 Nov 2026: the KumbhDoot AI framework is reported to include an optional, consent-based Kumbh Pass in DigiLocker (pilot planned); it is not described as a requirement.

facts.subject: Kumbh Mela transport
facts.display: Planned (long-distance specials and short-distance MEMU services); no timetable or routes located

source.name: PIB — Ministry of Railways release on Nashik Simhastha preparations

facts.notes: Railways describe a significantly higher number of special trains as planned for the Mela, with long-distance specials and short-distance MEMU services. No train numbers, routes, dates or booking opening have been located. Shuttle buses (earlier guide copy) have not been announced in any source we located. Check IRCTC, Central Railway and MSRTC.

facts.subject: Kumbh Mela roads, traffic and parking
facts.fact: Official parking and traffic plan for the Mela
facts.display: Three-tier plan reported: on Amrut Snan days private vehicles stop at outer parking; about 4,500 MSRTC shuttle buses carry pilgrims onward (planning figures)

source.name: Free Press Journal — 4,500 buses planned for Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027

facts.notes: Press reports (June 2026) of the Authority's planning: outer, outer 1 and inner parking tiers; 46 parking locations in Nashik and 26 in Trimbakeshwar; only outer tiers on Amrut Snan days. Figures are planning estimates. Parking locations and fares not published. No official notice opened by an editor.

facts.subject: Kumbh Mela health arrangements
facts.fact: Healthcare plan reported for the Simhastha
facts.value: 136 temporary healthcare facilities and 190 ambulances (on bathing days)
facts.display: Reported: 136 temporary healthcare facilities and 190 ambulances on bathing days

source.name: Free Press Journal (Pune/Nashik)

facts.notes: Press coverage reports that the Authority approved a healthcare plan including temporary hospitals and clinics at ghats, Sadhugram, parking areas and routes, ALS and BLS ambulances, and additional staff and beds. The Authority's own notice has not been linked, and exact locations and opening dates are not published. Earlier guide copy gave other specifics (such as 200 m camp spacing); those are not sourced.
